summary.text: Tom Determann is a Republican state representative from Iowa House District 69 who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as president of Determann Industries Inc.

paragraphs.text: Tom Determann was first elected to Iowa House District 69 in 2022, defeating Democrat Jennifer Hansen in the general election on November 8, 2022.
He won re-election on November 5, 2024, defeating Randy Meier.

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia shows him assigned to the House Commerce, Economic Growth, House Local Government and House Transportation committees, with the Transportation committee listing him as vice chair.
In 2026 he advanced from the June 2 Republican primary and faces Randy Meier, the Democratic nominee, again in the general election.
